purpose: Define how a genuinely confirmatory protected test must be produced and frozen after Gate C without contaminating candidate development.

requirements.spec_version: PDA-SPEC-v2 / schema 2.0.0 unless a future Gate-B cycle explicitly supersedes it
requirements.oracle_source: same frozen oracle lineage as the benchmark unless superseded before protected generation
requirements.seed: held outside candidate-development access until candidate freeze
requirements.access_control: candidate developers must not inspect oracle-private protected labels or seed before candidate freeze
requirements.single_confirmatory_read: protected results are not used for iterative tuning; any post-result modification creates a new exploratory candidate and cannot reuse the same confirmatory claim

current_gate_c_public_holdout: The deterministic protected_test split generated by Gate C is useful for split-integrity and freeze mechanics only. Because repository code can regenerate it, it is explicitly not counted as independent Gate-F protected evidence.
gate_f_precondition: A separately isolated protected set or independent reproduction process is required before protected-validation credit can be awarded.
